description: This file defines a Python class 'Neo4jClient' that provides methods for interacting with a Neo4j database, including initialization, upserting entities and relationships, and persisting embeddings. It handles configuration via environment variables or settings, manages connections, retries transient errors, and includes logging. It serves as a client abstraction for Neo4j database operations within a larger application.

classes.name: Neo4jClient
classes.description: A client class for connecting to and performing upsert operations in a Neo4j database, with configuration handling, connection management, retries, and logging.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Neo4j client, sets up the driver if properly configured, and verifies connectivity.

methods.description: Context manager that provides an active Neo4j session if configured, otherwise yields None.
